task_metadata.research_topic: protein inverse folding and structure encoder design
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel GNN-based structure encoder for protein inverse folding.
notes: No stub.py exists in this task folder; the implementation stub is custom_template.py.
TS50 did not surface a standalone benchmark paper in citation search, so it is linked to papers that explicitly report TS50 results.

tests.label: CATH4.2
tests.notes: Single-chain inverse-folding benchmark used by ProteinMPNN and PiFold.

tests.label: CATH4.3
tests.notes: Updated CATH benchmark; linked to methods and the CATH v4.4 database expansion paper.

tests.label: TS50
tests.notes: Out-of-distribution benchmark; cited by multiple inverse-folding papers.

baselines.name: pifold
baselines.notes: PiFold baseline from arXiv 2022 / ICLR 2023 line of work.
